integrity.method: explicit complete finite enumeration, global acyclic Hasse matching, signed Lefschetz traces, independent mod-two boundary reductions

scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary four-cut complex of the fixed 13-vertex Paley graph is classified.
No higher-order Paley or different-cutoff family theorem and no equivariant homotopy type.
Rational representation decomposition, not an integral group-lattice decomposition.
Quotient is classified only up to rational homology, not homotopy.
Independent external scientific audit has not been performed; equivalent unindexed prior work may exist.
title: Paley-thirteen four-cut homotopy and its affine homology character
